item.title: Pavements all along road covered in weeds, 18th October
item.description:
Subject: Overgrown Weeds and Uneven Pavement – Brownspring Drive, SE9 I wish to report an ongoing maintenance issue along Brownspring Drive, SE9, where the pavement and kerb edges are heavily overgrown with weeds. This problem has persisted for several months and remains unresolved. Although the grass verges have recently been cut, the weeds growing along the pavement and kerb edges have not been dealt with. The overgrowth appears to be causing movement and displacement of the paving, creating uneven surfaces and a potential trip hazard for pedestrians. It is particularly concerning that the surrounding roads have clear, well-maintained pavements with no weeds, while Brownspring Drive has been left in this condition for months. This raises concerns about the inconsistency in maintenance and the standard of upkeep along this stretch of road. The condition of the pavement presents a safety risk, particularly for older residents, people with mobility difficulties and other pedestrians. Please arrange for the weeds to be properly removed and the pavement to be inspected for any damage or displacement caused by the overgrowth. Given the length of time this issue has persisted and the potential risk to pedestrians, I ask that it be treated as a priority. I would appreciate confirmation of when this issue will be investigated and what action will be taken to ensure that Brownspring Drive receives the same standard of pavement maintenance as the surrounding roads. Thank you.
Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Brownspring Drive, Eltham
Report on FixMyStreet
